schema.description: Returned when the agent has tools the caller must authorize before the run can start. Each entry in `authenticationSuggestions` names one such tool; POST its `serverId` to `/tool-servers/{serverId}/auth` with `returnUrl` in the request body to obtain an `authorizationUrl` to redirect the end user to, then retry the run once OAuth completes.
